title: Ores Remaster
description: Ores Remaster is a content-focused Minecraft mod that breathes new life into the mining and progression system.
body:
-  Overview

Ores Remaster is a content-focused Minecraft mod that breathes new life into the mining and progression system by introducing three new fully integrated ores—Obsidian, Silver, and Flintstone. Each ore is carefully designed to fill the gaps between existing vanilla materials, offering smoother gear progression, more mining incentives, and meaningful customization for armor and tools.

- Why Use Ores Remaster?

Smoother Progression: No more harsh jumps from Iron to Diamond or Diamond to Netherite. Enjoy a layered gear curve that encourages exploration and resource management.

Vanilla-Friendly Balance: All new materials are balanced around existing vanilla stats to feel natural and immersive—no overpowered tools or unreasonably rare ores.

Customization & Playstyle: Choose your armor and tools based on playstyle—tank with Obsidian, specialize in undead combat with Silver, or stay agile with Flintstone.

Enhanced Exploration: With new ores distributed across different depths and biomes, mining is more rewarding and varied.

--------



Configuration



Modpack-ready and compatible with most world generation and mining overhaul mods
